rationale: The assistant immediately issued the correct safety stop ('Please don't keep resetting the trip. Leave the appliance unplugged'), explained the earth-leakage mechanism, and asked one well-targeted question about timing relative to heating, which the customer confirmed. It kept its diagnosis appropriately hedged ('probably', 'most likely the heater element') and correctly routed the fix to an engineer's insulation test rather than telling the customer to buy a part. It did not check for water near the socket or mention calling an electrician if trips continued with the dishwasher unplugged, so coverage of the important unknowns was slightly incomplete, but the homeowner was left safe and well informed.
